name: cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily C member 8

function.text: CYP2C8 is the approved symbol for cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily C member 8. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in arachidonate 11,12-epoxygenase activity; arachidonate 14,15-epoxygenase activity; epoxygenase P450 pathway.

function.text: CYP2C8 encodes cytochrome P450 family 2 subfamily C member 8. It catalyzes the hydroxylation of carbon-hydrogen bonds. It metabolizes all trans-retinoic acid toward its 4-hydroxylated form. It displays 16-alpha hydroxylase activity toward estrogen steroid hormones, 17beta-estradiol (E2) and estrone (E1).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CYP2C8 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma.
